import { CardGrid, LinkCard } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Two kinds of builder meet in this tab. The **author** models the business:
record types, fields, views, and rules, built in the app or in files. The
**developer** builds the apps that use that data: browser apps, backend
services, and AI agents. The tutorials below take both of you from an empty
server to a working domain and a shipped app.

If you are still deciding whether Facet fits, start with
[The big picture](/discover/how-it-works/) instead.
